title: Zealot's Chest

__NOTOC__{{interactive object infobox | type = Dungeon Chest | image = [[Image:Dungeon reward chest.jpg|150px]] | campaign = Prophecies}} {{stub}} {{Reforgedmodecontent}} The [[Zealot's Chest]] will spawn after defeating [[Varny the Zealot]] in the final level of the [[Tunnels of the Forsaken]] dungeon. Each player in the party may open the chest and will receive one item from the drop list in normal mode (2 in hard mode).

After the chest has been opened by all players, a three minute countdown timer will begin to return players back to [[Piken Square]]. ==Location== [[Prophecies]] *[[Tunnels of the Forsaken ]] - Level 3 ==Drops== ''Drop Research is ongoing, and may be found [[Zealot's Chest/Research|here]].'' ===Rare crafting materials=== *[[Ruby]] *[[Sapphire]] *[[Diamond]] *[[Onyx Gemstone]] ===Weapons=== *Random [[inscribable]] weapon *[[Eternal Blade]] ===Dyes=== *[[Vial of Dye]] (Black) *[[Vial of Dye]] (White) ===Additional bonus drops, only from this chest=== * [[Miniature Ghost of Althea]] * [[Miniature Undead Prince]] * [[Cracked Ascalonian War Horn]] * [[Cracked Ascalonian War Horn (unique)|Cracked Ascalonian War Horn]] ([[unique]]) == Notes == The highly sought after [[Crystalline Sword]] does not appear to drop from this chest, however it does drop from the boss required to be killed to spawn this chest, [[Varny the Zealot]] [[Category:Dungeon chests]]
